name: libliftoff
description: Lightweight library that eases the use of KMS hardware overlay planes from userspace: compositors create virtual 'layers', set KMS properties on them, and libliftoff allocates real planes for them when possible, falling back to composition otherwise.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
